conformed_to: FITA_FORMAT_STANDARD.md v1.1 RATIFIED + FITA_AMENDMENT__2026-08-02.md (proposed v1.2). Where this card and the standard disagree, the standard governs.
purpose: Self-description of the FITA format for AI agents. Read this first: it tells you what a .fita file is, what is trustworthy inside it, WHICH KNOWN DEFECTS affect files you will encounter, and which operations are safe to perform unattended. Generated from the same Op/spec metadata that drives the CLI and MCP server, so it does not drift from the tools.

format.name: FITA
format.mime_note: Standard §3 [CORRECTION]: 'application/fits+alpha' is NOT registered with IANA and MUST NOT be emitted into provenance metadata. Conformant files declare access_format = 'application/fits'. Do not repeat the +alpha type as though it were registered.
format.magic: SIMPLE = T (every .fita is a valid FITS MEF; measured: 18/18 files pass verify('exception') with 0 warnings)
format.current_spec: 1.2 — amendment PROPOSED 2026-08-02, not yet folded into the canonical standard on ATOP. v1.1 was ratified the same day; 1.2 adds only OPTIONAL structure (FITA_ADJ schema, FITA_ZRF/FITA_ZAN).
format.as_built_files: Files before 2026-08-02 declare 1.0 and carry the legacy defects (GRANDFATHERED under D-1). Files written today may declare 1.1 or 1.2; both are readable, the added structure is OPTIONAL throughout.

FITO.role: ISM energy-budget calculation object; CONSUMES FITA/FITR

FITSA.note: DIFFERENT older format (annotated event cutouts). One-letter name hazard — never abbreviate either as 'the FITS-A format'.

core_invariant.statement: FLUX is sacred; ALPHA is display. FLUX_* holds calibrated physical flux — it IS the science. ALPHA_* is display-only transparency derived from a selected flux range. Deriving, recomputing or overriding alpha MUST NOT modify FLUX_* by any amount, including round-off.
core_invariant.why_it_matters_to_you: Any answer about physical brightness, SED, or photometry must come from FLUX_*, never from ALPHA_* or a composited display raster. Re-deriving alpha is always safe and reversible.
core_invariant.measured_status: HOLDS EXACTLY in the default FLOAT32 mode — round-trip returns numpy.array_equal == True, 0 of 4096 pixels altered. The format's central promise is kept.
core_invariant.exception: Was violated catastrophically under FITAPACK='SPLIT16'. D-2 ruled DELETE: the writer now raises on both write and read, so no conformant path can produce or consume it. See known_defects.R5.

hdu_layout.name: PRIMARY
hdu_layout.role: no data; global keywords FITAVER, FITAPACK, FITANL (MUST); FITACW/FITACH, BUNIT (SHOULD)

hdu_layout.name: FITA_LAYERS
hdu_layout.role: BINTABLE layer index — NON-AUTHORITATIVE (see authority rule)

hdu_layout.name: FLUX_nnnn
hdu_layout.role: IMAGE, calibrated flux, BITPIX=-32 under FLOAT32. REQUIRED. Header is AUTHORITATIVE.

hdu_layout.name: UNCERT_nnnn
hdu_layout.role: IMAGE, BITPIX=-32, 1-sigma, same units as its FLUX_*. OPTIONAL.

hdu_layout.name: MASK_nnnn
hdu_layout.role: IMAGE, BITPIX=8 bitmask: bit0 bad, bit1 saturated, bit2 cosmic ray, bit3 gap. OPTIONAL.

hdu_layout.name: FITA_ADJ
hdu_layout.role: BINTABLE adjustment stack -- non-destructive display state. OPTIONAL at every level. IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-02 (D-3): columns ORDER, ADJ_TYPE, ENABLED, NAME, LAYER_ID, PARAMS(JSON). Write via io.write(adjustments=...), read via io.read_adjustments(path). Written at HDU N-1, before FITA_META. Satisfies FITR_SPEC S8's dependency.

hdu_layout.name: FITA_META
hdu_layout.role: BINTABLE provenance, ObsCore DM v1.2. OPTIONAL at FITA-CORE, REQUIRED at FITA-FULL. Reachable via io.write(provenance=...) since 2026-08-02. Written LAST per S4.1.

authority_rule.statement: The FLUX_* extension header is NORMATIVE. FITA_LAYERS is a non-authoritative index (standard §4.3).
authority_rule.for_agents: Read layer metadata from the FLUX_* header. Use FITA_LAYERS only to enumerate layers without touching image data. Where they disagree, the header wins and a validator should report the discrepancy.
authority_rule.also: Never re-apply BSCALE/BZERO to data a FITS library has already scaled (standard §2.2).

MUST.FITA_BLD: blend-mode code — unknown codes MUST raise, never fall back to NORMAL
MUST.FITA_VIS: layer visibility — NEW in v1.1; absent from all v1.0 files, see known_defects.R3

zdp_stereo_depth.meaning: FITA_ZDP encodes PHYSICAL ISM penetration depth, not arbitrary stacking order. 0.0 = deepest/background, 1.0 = foreground.
zdp_stereo_depth.renderer_note: A renderer SHOULD apply a differential x-offset proportional to ZDP for binocular parallax. The standard deliberately does NOT specify the parallax scaling — that is a property of a rendering job, not a file.
zdp_stereo_depth.absence: Absence MUST be encoded by omitting the keyword, not by a negative sentinel.

blend_modes.rules: All operate on float32 normalised to [0,1] and are DISPLAY operations — they MUST NOT be applied to FLUX_*. An unknown code MUST raise.
blend_modes.gotcha_for_agents: The four HSL modes need 3-channel input. On single-channel data the implementation promotes to greyscale, which makes LUM mathematically IDENTICAL to NORMAL — so LUM, though advertised as the canonical multi-band mode, is a no-op on a single layer.
blend_modes.practice: ADD/SCREEN for emission-line compositing; LUM for false-colour where brightness comes from the science layer and hue from a reference layer.

provenance_paci.status: NOT a standard §6.2 keyword set — a uranodyne convention written into layer extra_header by uranodyne.pipeline.paci. Its place in the format is an OPEN QUESTION (design D-8): standard §10.3 assigns 'epistemic status' to the sibling format FITO, and ANCHORCL is epistemic status.

anchor_class_meaning.MEASURED: directly measured native-resolution quantity — highest trust
anchor_class_meaning.SCOUTED: coarse prior from a low-resolution wide-field product, not yet point-confirmed
anchor_class_meaning.ANCHORED: a SCOUTED value reconciled against >=1 MEASURED point and promoted

provenance_paci.rule_for_agents: When you report a value, report its ANCHORCL if present. Never treat SCOUTED as MEASURED. Operations combining layers must DEMOTE to the least-trusted input. Do not assume PACI is present — it is not part of FITA-CORE.

conformance_levels.note: The standard defines EXACTLY TWO levels (§2.1). Earlier drafts of the Foundry design invented a four-level L0..L3 scheme — that scheme is withdrawn; do not use it.
conformance_levels.FITA-CORE: every MUST in standard §§3-7 satisfied. Minimum for a file to be called .fita; what any reader may assume.
conformance_levels.FITA-FULL: FITA-CORE + every SHOULD in S3-9 + a conformant ObsCore v1.2 FITA_META HDU. REACHABLE as of 2026-08-02 -- pass provenance= to io.write()/FITACube.save().
conformance_levels.validator: fita.validate(path) -> ConformanceReport — BUILT. Exposed as the CLI command `fita conform` (--quiet, --strict; exit 0/1/2). Report carries Finding(clause, severity) plus .is_core/.is_full/.level. flux_roundtrip_ok() implements the standard S5.4 bit-exactness check.
conformance_levels.nan_gotcha: S5.4 bit-exactness MUST be NaN-aware: np.array_equal is False whenever NaN is present (NaN != NaN) and real astro images are full of blanked pixels. Compare NaN masks and non-NaN pixels separately.

known_defects.preamble: STATUS 2026-08-02: ALL SIX defects are now FIXED in the writer. The distinction that matters to you is TEMPORAL: files written before 2026-08-02 still carry the legacy defects (wrapped alpha, invalid BUNIT, no FITA_META); files written after do not. Always run validate() rather than assuming.

R1_alpha_wrap.what: Alpha written as signed int16 with NO BZERO=32768, so every value above 32767 (more than half-opaque) is stored NEGATIVE.
R1_alpha_wrap.scope: ALL 18 archived files. In one file every alpha plane is uniformly -1, which is 65535 (fully opaque) wrapped.
R1_alpha_wrap.why_invisible: The library's read path casts straight back to uint16, so the wrap is undone by a matching bug INSIDE FITA.
R1_alpha_wrap.consequence_for_you: DS9, QFitsView and Aladin have no compensating bug — they read alpha as -32768..32767. This is the precise sense in which FITA v1.0 is structurally legal FITS but semantically wrong. No FLUX is affected.
R1_alpha_wrap.note: The Zarr backend already writes alpha correctly as uint16 — the FITS writer is the outlier.
R1_alpha_wrap.status_2026_08_02: FIXED 2026-08-02 — io.py writes uint16, astropy emits BZERO=32768; verified range 0..65535. LEGACY FILES STILL AFFECTED.

R2_meta_unreachable.what: fita.ivoa.make_meta_hdu() works, but fita.io.write() has no parameter to pass it and never appends it.
R2_meta_unreachable.consequence_for_you: FITA_META is absent from all 18 files and FITA-FULL is unreachable through the documented API. Do not assume provenance exists.
R2_meta_unreachable.status_2026_08_02: FIXED 2026-08-02 -- io.write(..., provenance=dict|BinTableHDU) appends FITA_META; FITACube.save() passes it through. FITA-FULL is now reachable through the documented API (verified: a written file validates FITA-FULL).

R3_visible_lost.what: Layer visibility is stored only in the FITA_LAYERS table; readers take everything from the header, so it is silently lost.
R3_visible_lost.scope: Every round trip, in BOTH the FITS and Zarr backends. A layer written visible=False reads back visible=True.
R3_visible_lost.fix: FITA_VIS keyword, new and required in v1.1.
R3_visible_lost.status_2026_08_02: FIXED — FITA_VIS required and emitted; visible round-trips [T,F,T].

R4_invalid_bunit.what: Two BUNIT values fail astropy unit parsing: 'alpha16' on every ALPHA_* header, and 'same as FLUX' on every UNCERT_* header.
R4_invalid_bunit.consequence_for_you: A pipeline trusting BUNIT on an uncertainty plane gets a parse error instead of an error bar. ALPHA_* should omit BUNIT or use ''; UNCERT_* must carry the parent FLUX_*'s actual unit string.
R4_invalid_bunit.status_2026_08_02: FIXED — 'alpha16' omitted; UNCERT carries the parent flux unit.

R5_split16_destructive.what: FITAPACK='SPLIT16' is not lossy — it is DESTRUCTIVE, and the file does not contain the information needed to recover flux at all. Three faults compound: int16 wrap, astropy discarding BSCALE/BZERO on integer data (written file has BSCALE=None, BZERO=None), and a read fallback to BSCALE=1/BZERO=0.
R5_split16_destructive.measured: Truth 10..1000 Jy read back as -32760..32759; max relative error 3.5e6; 4096 of 4096 pixels altered; brightest pixel read back as -1.
R5_split16_destructive.status: DEPRECATED in v1.1. A conformant writer MUST NOT emit it; a reader encountering it MUST RAISE rather than return flux values.
R5_split16_destructive.scope: 0 of 18 archived files use it — no archived science is harmed.
R5_split16_destructive.do_not_repeat: The widely-quoted '~1.5e-5 relative error' describes only the encoder function in isolation and has NEVER described the file format. Even repaired, the quantum is a constant ABSOLUTE step of (FMAX-FMIN)/65535, so relative error approaches 100% for faint pixels; and default percentile auto-ranging clips away the brightest and faintest 0.5% of pixels outright.
R5_split16_destructive.status_2026_08_02: FIXED — D-2 ruled DELETE; io.py raises on BOTH write and read. 0 of 18 archived files ever used it.

R6_obscore_overclaim.what: 'ObsCore DM v1.1 compliant' is an OVERCLAIM and is withdrawn. Mandatory columns are missing (obs_publisher_did, s_region, access_estsize, o_ucd, s_xel1, s_xel2, t_xel, em_xel) and per-column UCDs are never written to the file — no TUCDn keywords are emitted.
R6_obscore_overclaim.correct_wording: ObsCore DM v1.2 (full mandatory column set, TUCDn annotated)
R6_obscore_overclaim.open: FITA declares ObsCore v1.1, FITR declares v1.2 — one version must be chosen for the family (standard D-4).
R6_obscore_overclaim.status_2026_08_02: FIXED 2026-08-02 -- D-4 implemented: all 26 ObsCore v1.2 mandatory columns present (32 total), every column carries a TUCDn, access_format = "application/fits". The honest wording is now "ObsCore DM v1.2" -- no longer a subset.

FITS-MEF.status: default; verified; but is the outlier on alpha encoding (R1)

Zarr.status: VERIFIED — flux bit-identical vs FITS; uncert, mask, WCS, zdepth, opacity, blend, name preserved; alpha correct as uint16

HDF5.status: UNVERIFIED — h5py not installed on ATOP, could not be exercised. The claim 'survives round-trip through all three backends' is confirmed for TWO of three.

backends.data_model_rule: The data model is container-independent and MUST be preserved identically across all three. 'visible' is lost by both testable backends — a data-model defect, not a container one.
backends.family_contract: Interconversion: FITS folder <=> FITS-MEF (FITA) <=> HDF5 (FITO/FITR), round-trip, with any lossy step LOGGED. A conversion that silently loses a property is non-conformant.

operations.note: Verbs of the FITA Foundry I/P/E bus (DESIGN, PARKed — see FITA_FOUNDRY_DESIGN.md v0.3). NOT YET BUILT. The only shipped CLI verbs are listed under interfaces.cli_today.

side_effect_legend.writes_file: creates/overwrites a file; safe with a named output path
side_effect_legend.network: fetches remote data; rate-limited; confirm if quota matters
side_effect_legend.external_app: drives another running application (DS9, Photoshop); confirm before use
side_effect_legend.irreversible: cannot be undone from the manifest; requires explicit human confirmation

process.name: reselect
process.does: re-derive alpha from new flux range/stretch

process.name: composite
process.does: blend visible layers to a display raster

process.name: adjust
process.caveat: IN MEMORY ONLY — nothing serialises the adjustment stack; it vanishes on save (FITA_ADJ is never written)

process.name: reproject
process.does: regrid a layer to target WCS

process.name: sed
process.does: extract SED at pixel/aperture from FLUX

process.name: pack
process.does: VESTIGIAL — SPLIT16 is deleted (D-2); no reachable input, no legal output. Recommend dropping.

sibling_boundary.rule: FITA MUST NOT acquire paradigm tags, [ESTABLISHED]/[PROPOSED — MWVO] fences, or (input, core, paradigm) stamps. A physics claim has no business in an image container.
sibling_boundary.FITA_holds: calibrated images + display metadata — 'what did the instrument record?'
sibling_boundary.FITO_holds: derived physical quantities + their epistemic status — 'what does that imply, under which paradigm?'
sibling_boundary.uncertainty: OPTIONAL in FITA (UNCERT_*), MANDATORY in FITO
sibling_boundary.direction: FITA is an INPUT to FITO; FITO consumes FITA and FITR and MUST NOT redefine flux storage.

agent_guidance.reading: To answer 'what is this file', report: FITAVER, conformance level from validate(), layer count and bands from the FLUX_* headers (not FITA_LAYERS), and the ANCHORCL distribution if PACI is present. Physical questions read FLUX_*; appearance questions read ALPHA_*/composite.
agent_guidance.always_state_defects: Run validate() first. Files written before 2026-08-02 (FITAVER 1.0) have wrapped alpha and invalid BUNIT -- warn before handing them to DS9/Aladin/QFitsView. Files written after are clean.
agent_guidance.safe_unattended: Any op with side_effect=pure, and writes_file ops when the user gave an output path.
agent_guidance.requires_confirmation: network (quota), external_app (drives another program), irreversible (no undo).
never_do: Do not treat a display raster or ALPHA as physical flux.
Do not upgrade an anchor class without a MEASURED reconciliation.
Do not emit FITAPACK='SPLIT16', and do not trust flux read from a SPLIT16 file — raise instead.
Do not emit 'application/fits+alpha' as a registered MIME type.
Do not claim ObsCore compliance; say 'ObsCore-derived subset'.
Do not repeat the '~1.5e-5 relative error' figure for SPLIT16.
Do not write paradigm or epistemic stamps into a .fita.
Do not overwrite the input .fita in place unless explicitly told to.
agent_guidance.extensibility: New Ops register via entry-point groups fita.ingest / fita.process / fita.emit and appear here automatically.
agent_guidance.reaching_full: To produce a VO-registerable file, pass provenance to the writer, e.g. write(path, layers, provenance={'obs_id': ..., 'facility': ..., 'ra': ..., 'dec': ..., 'extra': {'obs_publisher_did': 'ivo://...', 'obs_collection': ..., 's_region': 'POLYGON ICRS ...'}}). Spatial/spectral extents and axis counts are derived from the layers automatically.

interfaces.cli_today: fita conform | doctor | from-fits | from-psd | reselect | info | rgb | ds9-plugin | liberator. `fita` is on PATH as of 2026-08-02 (user PATH); `python -m fita` also works.
interfaces.python: from fita import FITACube, FITALayer; FITACube(layers=..., adjustments=AdjustmentStack([...])).save(path, provenance={...})

adjustments.what: Non-destructive display transforms applied in sequence at composite time. They NEVER modify FLUX_* (standard S5.2).

types.BANDMAP: assign a layer to an R/G/B display channel (false colour)
types.FXNORM: divide by an instrument response curve

adjustments.serialisation: Common parameters are REAL TYPED COLUMNS (author ruling Q1, 2026-08-02): ORDER, ADJ_TYPE, ENABLED, NAME, LAYER_ID + IN_BLACK/IN_WHITE/GAMMA/OUT_BLACK/OUT_WHITE, BRIGHT/CONTRAST, STRETCH/ASINH_A/POWER_EXP, CHANNEL, WAVE_CVAL. A JSON PARAMS column is reserved for the genuinely variable-length fields only (control_points, response_curve, wavelengths) and is auto-sized to the longest row. Inapplicable columns use the D-5 absence convention: NaN for floats, empty for text.
adjustments.rule_for_agents: An unknown ADJ_TYPE MUST raise, never be silently dropped -- the same rule S8.1 sets for unknown blend modes. A display stack that quietly loses a step is worse than one that refuses to load.
adjustments.gotcha: Before 2026-08-02 nothing serialised the stack: adjustments existed in memory and vanished on save, and the old to_records() emitted an empty parameter dict, so a 'round trip' silently restored DEFAULT adjustments. When checking a round trip, compare parameter VALUES, not just that an adjustment came back.
adjustments.why_typed: A reader that can open the file but cannot see that GAMMA = 2.2 has not really been given the data. FITA's premise is that any FITS reader can open it, so the parameters must be legible in the table.
adjustments.status: IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-02 and specified in FITA_AMENDMENT__2026-08-02.md S3.5 (new S8.3) — PROPOSED, not yet in the canonical standard.

keywords.FITA_ZSC: total horizontal parallax in PIXELS across the full ZDP range (OPTIONAL, renderer-written)
keywords.FITA_ZRF: the ZDP value placed at ZERO parallax (the screen plane). Default 0.0 when omitted.
keywords.FITA_ZAN: angular measure of the full-range parallax, arcsec on sky (OPTIONAL)

stereo_geometry.convention: dx = +/- (FITA_ZSC / 2) * (FITA_ZDP - FITA_ZRF);  left eye -, right eye +
stereo_geometry.reference_plane: With ZRF=0.0 the background sits at the screen and everything is pushed forward. With ZRF=0.5 the mid-depth layer sits at the screen, so HI recedes BEHIND it and X-ray plasma comes forward -- the depth budget is spent in both directions about a chosen plane.
stereo_geometry.angular_rule: Author ruling Q2: a bare pixel count satisfies the real->model metric chain ONLY when a complete model is missing. Otherwise an angular measure is required UNLESS deducible from context -- a celestial WCS is that context (pixel scale x FITA_ZSC). fita.stereo.angular_parallax() performs the deduction; the validator raises a SHOULD when the angle is neither recorded nor deducible.
stereo_geometry.rule_for_agents: Report which it is: recorded, deduced from WCS, or pixel-only. Never fabricate a pixel scale to manufacture an angle -- angular_parallax() returns None rather than guessing. Also note None != 0.0 for FITA_ZSC: None means no renderer recorded a geometry, 0.0 means one did and it was flat.
stereo_geometry.status: IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-02 and specified in FITA_AMENDMENT__2026-08-02.md S3.4 — PROPOSED, not yet in the canonical standard. FITA_ZAN sky-vs-viewing-angle semantics remain OPEN.
